items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Les Lee Konig found Ornette first... [INTERVIEWEE] A Chicago critic. Wrote a big article about him.

ctx.x: Like, Bessie Errine discovered Nesuhi Ertegun Artie Ornette Coleman, as far as I know. He brought him out to -- what's that, Brandeis?
Oh, no, brought him out to the place in the Berkshires, that school -- I remember that school of music. But, actually, Les Lee Konig found Ornette first, a guy in contemporary records.
